Data-driven market research, proforma analysis, and cap rate benchmarking to help investors and tenants make confident, informed decisions
Expert site selection and feasibility analysis tailored to your business footprint, tenant mix strategy, and gross leasable area requirements
End-to-end transaction management covering listing, marketing, negotiations, due diligence, and estoppel certificate coordination
Investment portfolio acquisition and disposition services optimized around net operating income, absorption rate, and capitalization rate targets
Ongoing commercial property management and post-close advisory to protect asset value and support future sale-leaseback or disposition strategies

conversion_actions.label: Schedule Market Consultation
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Capture investor or tenant prospect contact details and property need, and book a market analysis or property tour session with an agency specialist

conversion_actions.label: Request a Property Tour
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Qualify the prospect's space requirements, target submarket, and timeline, then schedule an in-person or virtual tour of available listings

conversion_actions.label: Browse Available Listings
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Direct the prospect to current office, retail, industrial, and investment property listings filtered by city, size, and transaction type

conversion_actions.label: Get a Proforma & Cap Rate Analysis
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Collect property address or target asset class and investor criteria, then connect the prospect with a broker to deliver a proforma analysis and capitalization rate benchmarking report

conversion_actions.label: List Your Commercial Property
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Gather property details including type, GLA, location, and ownership structure, and initiate the listing intake process with the agency's transaction team

conversion_actions.label: Subscribe to Market Reports
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Capture the prospect's email and asset class interests to deliver recurring commercial real estate analytics, vacancy rate trends, and absorption rate updates for their target market
